- text: 多幸運 有妳一起看星星 在爭寵

- text: 讓雙腳去騰空

- text: 讓我們去感受
  start_ms: 61390

- text: 那無憂的真空 那月色純真的感動

lines:
- text: 林宥嘉 - 想自由
  start_ms: 600
  end_ms: 1600
- text: 词：姚若龙
  start_ms: 1600
  end_ms: 2600
- text: 曲：郑楠
  start_ms: 2600
  end_ms: 27620
- text: 每个人都缺乏什么
  start_ms: 27620
  end_ms: 35350
- text: 我们才会瞬间就不快乐
  start_ms: 35350
  end_ms: 41150
- text: 单纯很难　包袱很多
  start_ms: 41150
  end_ms: 48930
- text: 已经很勇敢　还是难过
  start_ms: 48930
  end_ms: 57210
- text: 许多事情都有选择
  start_ms: 57210
  end_ms: 64510
- text: 只是往往事后我才懂得
  start_ms: 64510
  end_ms: 70610
- text: 情绪很烦　说话很冲
  start_ms: 70610
  end_ms: 78490
- text: 人和人的沟通
  start_ms: 78490
  end_ms: 81880
- text: 有时候没有用
  start_ms: 81880
  end_ms: 85100
- text: 或许只有妳　懂得我
  start_ms: 85100
  end_ms: 89010
- text: 所以妳没逃脱
  start_ms: 89010
  end_ms: 92990
- text: 一边在泪流　一边紧抱我
  start_ms: 92990
  end_ms: 96490
- text: 小声地说　多么爱我
  start_ms: 96490
  end_ms: 100640
- text: 只有妳　懂得我
  start_ms: 100640
  end_ms: 103690
- text: 就像被困住的野兽
  start_ms: 103690
  end_ms: 107700
- text: 在摩天大楼　渴求　自由
  start_ms: 107700
  end_ms: 127330
- text: 一路嗅着追着美梦
  start_ms: 127330
  end_ms: 134630
- text: 爬上屋顶意外跌得好重
  start_ms: 134630
  end_ms: 140770
- text: 不觉得痛　是觉得空
  start_ms: 140770
  end_ms: 148530
- text: 城市的幻影　有千百种
  start_ms: 148530
  end_ms: 157190
- text: 就算爱也会变冷的
  start_ms: 157190
  end_ms: 164400
- text: 可是现在抱的妳是暖的
  start_ms: 164400
  end_ms: 170150
- text: 我不晓得　我不舍得
  start_ms: 170150
  end_ms: 178160
- text: 为将来的难测
  start_ms: 178160
  end_ms: 181420
- text: 就放弃这一刻

  end_ms: 58790
- text: 他們說 要縫好你的傷 沒有人愛小丑

  end_ms: 65960

  end_ms: 73570

  end_ms: 92110

  end_ms: 99540
- text: 戰嗎? 戰啊! 以最卑微的夢

  end_ms: 103140
- text: 致那黑夜中的嗚咽與怒吼

  end_ms: 110410
- text: 誰說站在光裡的才算英雄?

  end_ms: 151160

  start_ms: 151160
  end_ms: 158650

  end_ms: 199930

  start_ms: 199930
  end_ms: 206600
- text: 愛你孤身走暗巷 愛你不跪的模樣

  end_ms: 210270

  end_ms: 214050
- text: 愛你來自於蠻荒 一生不借誰的光
  start_ms: 214050
  end_ms: 217620
- text: 你將造你的城邦在廢墟之上
  start_ms: 217620
  end_ms: 221200
- text: 去嗎? 去啊! 以最卑微的夢
  start_ms: 221200
  end_ms: 224950
- text: 戰嗎? 戰啊! 以最孤高的夢
  start_ms: 224950
  end_ms: 228710
- text: 致那黑夜中的嗚咽與怒吼
  start_ms: 228710

  start_ms: 235970

  你額頭的傷口 你的不同 你犯的錯
  都不必隱藏
  你破舊的玩偶 你的面具 你的自我

  他們說 要帶著光 馴服每一頭怪獸
  他們說 要縫好你的傷 沒有人愛小丑
  為何孤獨不可光榮?
  人只有不完美 值得歌頌
  誰說污泥滿身的不算英雄?

  愛你孤身走暗巷 愛你不跪的模樣
  愛你對峙過絕望 不肯哭一場
  愛你破爛的衣裳 卻敢堵命運的槍
  愛你和我那麼像 缺口都一樣

  去嗎? 配嗎? 這襤褸的披風
  戰嗎? 戰啊! 以最卑微的夢
  致那黑夜中的嗚咽與怒吼
  誰說站在光裡的才算英雄?

  他們說 要戒了你的狂 就像擦掉了污垢
  他們說 要順台階而上 而代價是低頭
  那就讓我不可乘風
  你一樣驕傲著 那種孤勇
  誰說對弈平凡的不算英雄?

  愛你孤身走暗巷 愛你不跪的模樣
  愛你對峙過絕望 不肯哭一場
  愛你破爛的衣裳 卻敢堵命運的槍
  愛你和我那麼像 缺口都一樣

  去嗎? 配嗎? 這襤褸的披風
  戰嗎? 戰啊! 以最卑微的夢
  致那黑夜中的嗚咽與怒吼
  誰說站在光裡的才算英雄?

  你的斑駁與眾不同
  你的沉默震耳欲聾 (you are the hero)

  愛你孤身走暗巷 愛你不跪的模樣
  愛你對峙過絕望 不肯哭一場 (you are the hero)
  愛你來自於蠻荒 一生不借誰的光
  你將造你的城邦 在廢墟之上

  去嗎? 去啊! 以最卑微的夢
  戰嗎? 戰啊! 以最孤高的夢
  致那黑夜中的嗚咽與怒吼
  誰說站在光裡的才算英雄?

- text: 都不必隱藏

- text: 他們說 要縫好你的傷 沒有人愛小丑
  start_ms: 58790
  end_ms: 65960
- text: 為何孤獨不可光榮? 人只有不完美值得歌頌

- text: 誰說污泥滿身的不算英雄?

- text: 愛你對峙過絕望 不肯哭一場

  end_ms: 88470

- text: 愛你和我那麼像 缺口都一樣

  Je me noie dans la vague de ton regard amoureux
  Je ne veux que ton âme divaguant sur ma peau
  Une fleur, une femme dans ton cœur Roméo
  Je ne suis que ton nom, le souffle lancinant
  De nos corps dans le sombre animés lentement
  Et la nuit je pleure des larmes qui coulent le long de mes joues
  Je ne pense à toi que quand le jour sombre, que s'abattent sur moi
  Mes tristes démons, dans l'abîme sans fond
  Aime-moi jusqu'à ce que les roses fanent
  Que nos âmes sombrent dans les limbes profondes

  Et la nuit, quand tout est sombre, je te regarde danser

  Je résonne en baisers, le long de ta poitrine
  Perdue dans l'avalanche de mon cœur égaré
  Qui es-tu, où es-tu
  Par les pleurs, par les rires de ton ombre effarée
  Je résonne en baisers
  Dans mon esprit tout divague, je me perds dans tes yeux
  Je me noie dans la vague de ton regard amoureux
  Je ne veux que ton âme divaguant sur ma peau
  Une fleur, une femme dans ton cœur Roméo
  Je ne suis que ton nom, le souffle lancinant
  De nos corps dans le sombre animés lentement

  Et la nuit quand tout est sombre je te regarde danser

  あちらこちらに作ったシンボルは

  それすら
  未来でいつか

  終わり迎えた証

  短い旅の記憶

  物語は終わり
  勇者は眠りにつく
  穏やかな日常を
  この地に残して
  時の流れは無情に
  人を忘れさせる
  そこに生きた軌跡も
  錆び付いていく

  言葉も願いも勇気も
  今も確かに私の中で
  生きている
  同じ途を選んだ
  それだけだったはずなのに
  いつの間にかどうして
  頬を伝う涙の理由をもっと
  知りたいんだ
  今更だって
  共に歩んだ旅路を辿れば

  きっと見つけられる

  格好つけてばかりだね
  あちらこちらに作ったシンボルは

  それすら
  未来でいつか

  あの旅を思い出せるように
  残された目印

  終わり迎えた証

  短い旅の記憶

  物語は終わり
  勇者は眠りにつく
  穏やかな日常を
  この地に残して
  時の流れは無情に
  人を忘れさせる
  そこに生きた軌跡も
  錆び付いていく
  それでも君の
  言葉も願いも勇気も
  今も確かに私の中で
  生きている
  同じ途を選んだ
  それだけだったはずなのに
  いつの間にかどうして
  頬を伝う涙の理由をもっと
  知りたいんだ
  今更だって
  共に歩んだ旅路を辿れば
  そこに君は居なくとも
  きっと見つけられる

  一人の旅へと発つ
  立ち寄る街で出会う

  相も変わらずお人好しで
  格好つけてばかりだね
  あちらこちらに作ったシンボルは
  勝ち取った平和の証
  それすら
  未来でいつか
  私が一人にならないように
  あの旅を思い出せるように
  残された目印

  今更だって

  芽吹いた命と共に

  artist: YOASOBI
  album: THE BOOK
  duration_ms: 194000
  instrumental: false
lines:
- text: まるで御伽の話
  start_ms: 710
  end_ms: 3030
- text: 終わり迎えた証
  start_ms: 3030
  end_ms: 5290
- text: 長過ぎる旅路から
  start_ms: 5290
  end_ms: 8210
- text: 切り出した一節
  start_ms: 8210
  end_ms: 9930
- text: それはかつてこの地に
  start_ms: 9930
  end_ms: 12290
- text: 影を落とした悪を
  start_ms: 12290
  end_ms: 14580
- text: 討ち取りし勇者との
  start_ms: 14580
  end_ms: 17170
- text: 短い旅の記憶
  start_ms: 17170
  end_ms: 20220
- text: ♪
  start_ms: 20220
  end_ms: 29580
- text: 物語は終わり
  start_ms: 29580
  end_ms: 31870
- text: 勇者は眠りにつく
  start_ms: 31870
  end_ms: 34160
- text: 穏やかな日常を
  start_ms: 34160
  end_ms: 37040
- text: この地に残して
  start_ms: 37040
  end_ms: 38790
- text: 時の流れは無情に
  start_ms: 38790
  end_ms: 41160
- text: 人を忘れさせる
  start_ms: 41160
  end_ms: 43400
- text: そこに生きた軌跡も
  start_ms: 43400
  end_ms: 46410
- text: 錆び付いていく
  start_ms: 46410
  end_ms: 47900
- text: それでも君の
  start_ms: 47900
  end_ms: 49910
- text: 言葉も願いも勇気も
  start_ms: 49910
  end_ms: 52120
- text: 今も確かに私の中で
  start_ms: 52120
  end_ms: 55380
- text: 生きている
  start_ms: 55380
  end_ms: 58240
- text: 同じ途を選んだ
  start_ms: 58240
  end_ms: 59860
- text: それだけだったはずなのに
  start_ms: 59860
  end_ms: 61880
- text: いつの間にかどうして
  start_ms: 61880
  end_ms: 63460
- text: 頬を伝う涙の理由をもっと
  start_ms: 63460
  end_ms: 68090
- text: 知りたいんだ
  start_ms: 68090
  end_ms: 69080
- text: 今更だって
  start_ms: 69080
  end_ms: 70260
- text: 共に歩んだ旅路を辿れば
  start_ms: 70260
  end_ms: 72700
- text: そこに君は居なくとも
  start_ms: 72700
  end_ms: 76130
- text: きっと見つけられる
  start_ms: 76130
  end_ms: 79420
- text: ♪
  start_ms: 79420
  end_ms: 87260
- text: 物語は続く
  start_ms: 87260
  end_ms: 89530
- text: 一人の旅へと発つ
  start_ms: 89530
  end_ms: 91890
- text: 立ち寄る街で出会う
  start_ms: 91890
  end_ms: 93630
- text: 人の記憶の中に残る君は
  start_ms: 93630
  end_ms: 96210
- text: 相も変わらずお人好しで
  start_ms: 96210
  end_ms: 98370
- text: 格好つけてばかりだね
  start_ms: 98370
  end_ms: 100840
- text: あちらこちらに作ったシンボルは
  start_ms: 100840
  end_ms: 103420
- text: 勝ち取った平和の証
  start_ms: 103420
  end_ms: 105130
- text: それすら
  start_ms: 105130
  end_ms: 106000
- text: 未来でいつか
  start_ms: 106000
  end_ms: 107170
- text: 私が一人にならないように
  start_ms: 107170
  end_ms: 109750
- text: あの旅を思い出せるように
  start_ms: 109750
  end_ms: 111950
- text: 残された目印
  start_ms: 111950
  end_ms: 115860
- text: ♪
  start_ms: 115860
  end_ms: 124180
- text: まるで御伽の話
  start_ms: 124180
  end_ms: 126500
- text: 終わり迎えた証
  start_ms: 126500
  end_ms: 128780
- text: 私を変えた出会い
  start_ms: 128780
  end_ms: 131220
- text: 百分の一の旅路
  start_ms: 131220
  end_ms: 134370
- text: 君の勇気をいつか
  start_ms: 134370
  end_ms: 136030
- text: 風がさらって
  start_ms: 136030
  end_ms: 137190
- text: 誰の記憶から消えてしまっても
  start_ms: 137190
  end_ms: 139650
- text: 私が未来に連れて行くから
  start_ms: 139650
  end_ms: 143480
- text: 君の手を取った
  start_ms: 143480
  end_ms: 144710
- text: あの日全て始まった
  start_ms: 144710
  end_ms: 146380
- text: くだらなくて
  start_ms: 146380
  end_ms: 147560
- text: 思わずふっと笑ってしまうような
  start_ms: 147560
  end_ms: 150010
- text: ありふれた時間が今も眩しい
  start_ms: 150010
  end_ms: 154640
- text: 知りたいんだ
  start_ms: 154640
  end_ms: 155630
- text: 今更だって
  start_ms: 155630
  end_ms: 156780
- text: 振り返るとそこにはいつでも
  start_ms: 156780
  end_ms: 159220
- text: 優しく微笑みかける
  start_ms: 159220
  end_ms: 162660
- text: 君がいるから
  start_ms: 162660
  end_ms: 168070
- text: ♪
  start_ms: 168070
  end_ms: 173640
- text: 新たな旅の始まりは
  start_ms: 173640
  end_ms: 175760
- text: 君が守り抜いたこの地に
  start_ms: 175760
  end_ms: 178830
- text: 芽吹いた命と共に
  start_ms: 178830
  end_ms: 185520
- text: ♪
  start_ms: 185520
plain: |-
  まるで御伽の話
  終わり迎えた証
  長過ぎる旅路から
  切り出した一節
  それはかつてこの地に
  影を落とした悪を
  討ち取りし勇者との
  短い旅の記憶
  ♪
  物語は終わり
  勇者は眠りにつく
  穏やかな日常を
  この地に残して
  時の流れは無情に
  人を忘れさせる
  そこに生きた軌跡も
  錆び付いていく
  それでも君の
  言葉も願いも勇気も
  今も確かに私の中で
  生きている
  同じ途を選んだ
  それだけだったはずなのに
  いつの間にかどうして
  頬を伝う涙の理由をもっと
  知りたいんだ
  今更だって
  共に歩んだ旅路を辿れば
  そこに君は居なくとも
  きっと見つけられる
  ♪
  物語は続く
  一人の旅へと発つ
  立ち寄る街で出会う
  人の記憶の中に残る君は
  相も変わらずお人好しで
  格好つけてばかりだね
  あちらこちらに作ったシンボルは
  勝ち取った平和の証
  それすら
  未来でいつか
  私が一人にならないように
  あの旅を思い出せるように
  残された目印
  ♪
  まるで御伽の話
  終わり迎えた証
  私を変えた出会い
  百分の一の旅路
  君の勇気をいつか
  風がさらって
  誰の記憶から消えてしまっても
  私が未来に連れて行くから
  君の手を取った
  あの日全て始まった
  くだらなくて
  思わずふっと笑ってしまうような
  ありふれた時間が今も眩しい
  知りたいんだ
  今更だって
  振り返るとそこにはいつでも
  優しく微笑みかける
  君がいるから
  ♪
  新たな旅の始まりは
  君が守り抜いたこの地に
  芽吹いた命と共に
  ♪
response.name: 勇者

  きっと見つけられる

  一人の旅へと発つ
  立ち寄る街で出会う

  格好つけてばかりだね
  あちらこちらに作ったシンボルは
  勝ち取った平和の証
  それすら
  未来でいつか
  私が一人にならないように
  あの旅を思い出せるように
  残された目印
  ♪
  まるで御伽の話

  風がさらって

  思わずふっと笑ってしまうような

  今更だって

lines:
- text: Ветер как ветер
  start_ms: 41090
  end_ms: 43910
- text: Несёт нас опять по новому кругу
  start_ms: 43910
  end_ms: 50290
- text: В чартерных рейсах
  start_ms: 50290
  end_ms: 53790
- text: Стаи людей направляются к югу
  start_ms: 53790
  end_ms: 59530
- text: ''
  start_ms: 59530
  end_ms: 69360
- text: Мы ведь тоже хотели
  start_ms: 69360
  end_ms: 72550
- text: На солнце взлететь прямо так
  start_ms: 72550
  end_ms: 76400
- text: Из нашей постели
  start_ms: 76400
  end_ms: 78640
- text: Я держал твою руку
  start_ms: 78640
  end_ms: 81810
- text: Когда ты мне сказала, что это
  start_ms: 81810
  end_ms: 86600
- text: Ещё один фильм про разлуку
  start_ms: 86600
  end_ms: 90860
- text: И я кричу - остановите плёнку
  start_ms: 90860
  end_ms: 95920
- text: Это кино я уже смотрел
  start_ms: 95920
  end_ms: 100320
- text: Эй, режиссёр заканчивай съёмку
  start_ms: 100320
  end_ms: 105040
- text: А он смеётся в объектив как в прицел
  start_ms: 105040
  end_ms: 112790
- text: Ещё один фильм про разлуку...
  start_ms: 112790
  end_ms: 121340
- text: Последние титры
  start_ms: 121340
  end_ms: 124690
- text: Ты уехала к морю, а я в холодные горы
  start_ms: 124690
  end_ms: 130940
- text: Обнялись на прощание
  start_ms: 130940
  end_ms: 134340
- text: И стукнулись сумки на фоне молчания
  start_ms: 134340
  end_ms: 140700
- text: Нам так жалко свободы
  start_ms: 140700
  end_ms: 143500
- text: Мы с тобою одной и той же породы

  Ei
  Ja godīgi, man nav simtprocentīgas ticamības par to
  Ka mana lidaparāta mērinstrumenti un ciparnīcas un pogas
  Nav tikai uzzīmētas
  Un man ir aizdomas, ka tas viss izdarīts ir ar roku
  Bet tā ir mana lidmašīna, un es esmu nolidojis jau visu dzīvi ar to
  Redzējis griežoties gada skaitļus, redzējis varas maiņas
  Gan sliktus, gan labus laikus
  Iluminatora dabas ainas
  Mūžīgā reisā pēc savas maizes
  Papīra spārniem samirkstot mākoņos tā, ka bail
  Un tad kalstot saules staros jau pēc smieklīgi maza laika
  Un zini ko?
  Debesīs man ir droši, uz zemes ir nemiers un posts
  Liesmām ceļoties, kāp karsta gaisa masas, no kurām es netieku nost
  Kad viss pārvēršas pelnos, es stāvu, ķipa, "kur ir mana lidmašīna?"
  Netīrās cilpas un Prāta Vētra, ei, ko tu man tagad vari izdarīt?

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter

  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!

plain: |-
  How does a bastard, orphan, son of a whore
  And a Scotsman, dropped in the middle of a forgotten
  Spot in the Caribbean by providence, impoverished, in squalor
  Grow up to be a hero and a scholar?

  The ten-dollar Founding Father without a father
  Got a lot farther by working a lot harder
  By being a lot smarter, by being a self-starter
  By 14, they placed him in charge of a trading charter

  And every day while slaves were being slaughtered and carted
  Away across the waves, he struggled and kept his guard up
  Inside, he was longing for something to be a part of
  The brother was ready to beg, steal, borrow, or barter

  Then a hurricane came, and devastation reigned
  Our man saw his future drip, dripping down the drain
  Put a pencil to his temple, connected it to his brain
  And he wrote his first refrain, a testament to his pain

  Well, the word got around, they said, "This kid is insane, man"
  Took up a collection just to send him to the mainland
  "Get your education, don't forget from whence you came, and
  The world's gonna know your name, what's your name, man?"

  Alexander Hamilton
  My name is Alexander Hamilton
  And there's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait, just you wait

  When he was ten, his father split, full of it, debt-ridden
  Two years later, see Alex and his mother bed-ridden
  Half-dead, sittin' in their own sick, the scent thick
  And Alex got better but his mother went quick

  Moved in with a cousin, the cousin committed suicide
  Left him with nothin' but ruined pride, something new inside
  A voice saying, Alex, you gotta fend for yourself
  He started retreatin' and readin' every treatise on the shelf

  There would have been nothin' left to do
  For someone less astute
  He woulda been dead or destitute
  Without a cent of restitution
  Started workin', clerkin' for his late mother's landlord
  Tradin' sugar cane and rum and all the things he can't afford
  Scammin' for every book he can get his hands on
  Plannin' for the future, see him now as he stands on
  The bow of a ship headed for a new land
  In New York, you can be a new man

  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  (In New York, you can be a new man) Just you wait!
  In New York, you can be a new man
  In New York! (New York)
  Just you wait!

  Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  We are waiting in the wings for you (waiting in the wings for you)
  You could never back down
  You never learned to take your time!

  Oh, Alexander Hamilton (Alexander Hamilton)
  When America sings for you
  Will they know what you overcame?
  Will they know you rewrote the game?
  The world will never be the same, oh

  The ship is in the harbor now
  See if you can spot him (just you wait)
  Another immigrant
  Comin' up from the bottom (just you wait)
  His enemies destroyed his rep
  America forgot him

  We fought with him
  Me? I died for him
  Me? I trusted him
  Me? I loved him
  And me? I'm the damn fool that shot him

  There's a million things I haven't done
  But just you wait!
  What's your name, man?
  Alexander Hamilton!
